title: crepis chrysantha subsp. minor
intro: Crepis chrysantha subsp. minor, commonly known as the lesser hawk's beard, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory problems due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Crepis chrysantha subsp. minor include its ability to act as a demulcent, soothing irritated tissues, and its diuretic properties, which help to increase urine production and relieve fluid retention. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
